reserved_Q_DA_79.consequence_for_phase2: NONE. The arms' ranking stands unqualified on this account.
reserved_Q_DA_79.finding: H0 FALSIFIED, BUT SHALLOW AND NEGLIGIBLE IN MAGNITUDE.
reserved_Q_DA_79.forward_refinement_not_retroactive: POST_GAP_QUEUE_UNRELIABLE remains a pre-declared refinement for FUTURE builds only. R-173(2) is explicit that this never becomes a retroactive edit to a built population, and nothing here proposes one.
reserved_Q_DA_79.interpretation: The exposure is REAL but SHALLOW. 195 of 645,851 rows (0.030%) are admitted OK while preceding their own book resync. Median and p90 resync lag both round to -0.0 s: almost every exposed row sits within milliseconds of the resync instant, and only the extreme tail reaches 1.135 s. EVERY gap was followed by a snapshot (0 slugs left unresynced), so there is no persistent unresynced state anywhere in the population. btc-only, because eth carries no PM gaps in this top-up.
reserved_Q_DA_79.question: R-173 ruled a PM gap excludes ROWS, not the window. Rows INSIDE a gap carry GAP_IN_HORIZON. This asked about rows AFTER a gap: queue-ahead needs book state, and BookState refuses to mutate until a full post-gap snapshot arrives, so a row can report status=OK while its qahead rests on a book that was never re-established. The status field describes the FILL HORIZON and says nothing about queue validity, which is why this could hide.
reserved_Q_DA_79.reading_PRE_COMMITTED_BEFORE_THE_NUMBER_: Q-DA-79(5), filed before this ran: Phase 2's gate is a PAIRED comparison on identical rows and all three arms see the same post-gap rows, so any unreliability is COMMON-MODE. A large exposed set would QUALIFY WHAT THE NUMBERS MEAN and would NOT invalidate the ranking between arms. At 0.030% of rows it cannot move a paired comparison at all. This reading was committed in advance precisely so it could not be inflated afterwards.
